purpose: Disambiguate the current compact-field exact row from the historical feature-only SAM3 paper row and record the first target-RGB-assisted boundary readout on the current field.

current_field_exact_coarse.interface: canonical SurfaceRegionV2 native multiscale scalar maps + frozen Occam 30/7 readout

current_field_target_rgb_grabcut_v1.interface: same immutable current-field scalar maps + target-camera RGB GrabCut boundary proposal + fixed no-GT posterior gates

candidate_acceptance.interpretation: The v1 gates accepted every proposal and therefore did not provide discriminative candidate selection; the result remains a valid fixed universal RGB readout, but gate quality is not established.

historical_feature_only_sam3.interface: historical rendered hybrid/HCD feature path + feature-only SAM3 training-view pseudo-mask boundary head
historical_feature_only_sam3.comparison_caveat: This remains the best legacy paper-facing row, but it must not be reported as evidence that the current compact field reaches 0.588944.

conclusion: Target RGB recovers 1.20 scene-macro mIoU points on the current exact field without changing localization, confirming a boundary/readout deficit. The remaining 5.96-point gap to the historical feature-only SAM3 row cannot be attributed to boundary quality alone and still implicates current-field semantic support and/or a stronger learned target-RGB boundary interface.
